name: v11.6.0
body:
## What's Changed
* chore: add manual Windows path regression check [skip ci] by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1382
* fix: send empty folders relative to the parent when sending from a drive root by @orshih6 in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1381
* feat: use browser native for store by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1383
* fix: improve ux by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1385
* fix: keep unicode case-fold data out of identifiers by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1386
* fix: enable ssh invitation typing and align mobile controls by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1389
* fix: remove send panel helper text by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1390
* refactor: simplify web workspace navigation by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1391
* fix: improve web ux by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1392
* feat: use native browser transfers by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1393
* build(deps-dev): bump vite from 8.1.5 to 8.3.5 in /web in the npm_and_yarn group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1384
* fix: late probe Fixes #1396 by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1398
* feat: use bundle by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1403

## New Contributors
* @orshih6 made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1381

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/schollz/croc/compare/v11.5.5...v11.6.0
